# Sentinel Vanguard (`sentinel_vanguard`) — spec sheet

| PoliceInterceptor | 2010s American AWD police pursuit sedan, 3.5 L twin-turbo V6 | 4 / 5 | 45,000 |

## Design note

The pursuit specialist. AWD and a twin-turbo V6 give it launch traction and mid-range punch to stay on a sports car's bumper in the city, and it is stable at speed. Heavy and tall, so it cannot match a real sports car through fast corners — it wins by never letting the gap open.

## How this car breaks

Same reinforced police front as the cruiser (push bar through to the rails) on a modern UHSS cell. AWD hardware under the floor means sill and centre-tunnel hits can take out drive to one axle. Heavier than it looks: it hurts what it hits.

## Sources (type)

- fleet spec-class data for 2010s AWD police pursuit vehicles
- owner dyno averages for 3.5 L twin-turbo V6s
- engineering tables (tire radius, ride frequency, caliper hydraulics)

All values are class-typical figures for the archetype, rounded; no single real vehicle is reproduced.

## Inertia

Box approximation about the CG, scaled for mass concentration (`k < 1`: mass near the centre, e.g. mid-engine; `k → 1`: mass at the ends):

```
I_roll  = k_r · m·(W² + H²)/12
I_pitch = k_p · m·(L² + H²)/12
I_yaw   = k_y · m·(W² + L²)/12
```

| Axis | Box (kg·m²) | k | `inertia_kgm2` |
|---|---|---|---|
| roll | 1066 | 0.80 | 850 |
| pitch | 4825 | 0.92 | 4440 |
| yaw | 5061 | 0.94 | 4760 |

## Aerodynamics

Frontal area A = 0.84·W·H = 2.53 m²; Cd = 0.33 → **CdA = 0.884 m²** + 0.05 m² (lightbar/push bar). Lift Cl·A front/rear = +0.08 / +0.10 m² (class-typical; positive = lift). No add-on aero (`aero_downforce_coeffs` = 0, mods add it).

## Engine

3.5 L DOHC V6, twin turbo, direct injection. Class-typical 2010s 3.5 TT V6 (~78 kW/L), boost plateau from 2500 rpm per fleet spec-class data and owner dynos.

| rpm | N·m | kW |
|---|---|---|
| 800 | 260 | 21.8 |
| 1200 | 330 | 41.5 |
| 1600 | 400 | 67.0 |
| 2000 | 455 | 95.3 |
| 2500 | 495 | 129.6 |
| 3000 | 495 | 155.5 |
| 3500 | 495 | 181.4 |
| 4000 | 495 | 207.3 |
| 4500 | 490 | 230.9 |
| 5000 | 490 | 256.6 |
| 5500 | 472 | 271.9 |
| 6000 | 420 | 263.9 |
| 6300 | 380 | 250.7 |

Peak **272 kW @ 5500 rpm**, **495 N·m @ 2500 rpm**. Idle 650 / redline 6000 / limiter 6300 rpm. Rotating inertia 0.18 kg·m² (class: 0.10 small four … 0.30 big-block). Engine braking 10% of peak torque = 50 N·m. Power-to-weight 131 kW/t.

## Drivetrain

6-speed automatic, AWD (modelled as fixed 55/45 split), open diffs. Layout **AWD, 55 % front**; front diff: open; rear diff: open. Clutch capacity 1.60 × peak torque = 790 N·m. Shift time 0.30 s.

| Gear | Ratio | Overall | km/h @ redline |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 4.48 | 14.16 | 56 |
| 2 | 2.87 | 9.07 | 88 |
| 3 | 1.84 | 5.81 | 137 |
| 4 | 1.41 | 4.46 | 179 |
| 5 | 1.00 | 3.16 | 252 |
| 6 | 0.74 | 2.34 | 341 |

Final drive 3.16, reverse 2.88. Speeds use the driven-wheel loaded radius 0.352 m.

## Suspension

Springs from ride frequency, `k = m_s·(2πf)²` with sprung corner mass `m_s = axle load/2 − unsprung`; dampers `c = 2ζ·√(k·m_s)`, ζ = 0.30 bump, rebound = 1.5 × bump.

| Axle | m_s | f | Wheel rate k | Bump c | Rebound c | Travel |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Front | 553 kg | 1.50 Hz | 49100 N/m | 3130 N·s/m | 4700 N·s/m | 0.17 m |
| Rear | 428 kg | 1.60 Hz | 43300 N/m | 2580 N·s/m | 3870 N·s/m | 0.18 m |

Anti-roll bars from a roll-gradient target of 3.0°/g with 60% of roll stiffness at the front. Roll arm h − h_rc = 0.462 m (roll centres 0.08 m F / 0.12 m R). Required total K_φ = m·g·arm/φ = 179765 N·m/rad; springs give k·t²/2 = 67679 F / 59667 R N·m/rad; bars supply the rest as `arb_n_per_m = K_bar/t²` = **14600 F / 4400 R N/m** (clamped at ≥ 0). Resulting gradient 3.0°/g, front share 60%. Bump stops 170000 N/m.

Alignment: camber -0.6° F / -0.9° R, toe +0.00° F / +0.15° R (+ = in), caster 5.5°.

## Brakes

Full-pedal line pressure 100 bar.

- Front: 350 mm disc, pistons per side 54 mm + 54 mm → A = 45.8 cm², r_eff = D/2 − 25 mm = 150 mm, pad μ = 0.42: T = 2·μ·p·A·r_eff = 2·0.42·100 bar·45.8 cm²·0.150 m = **5771 N·m**
- Rear: 345 mm disc, pistons per side 44 mm → A = 15.2 cm², r_eff = D/2 − 25 mm = 148 mm, pad μ = 0.4: T = 2·μ·p·A·r_eff = 2·0.4·100 bar·15.2 cm²·0.147 m = **1794 N·m**

Lock check at 1 g on μ = 1 (load transfer m·a·h/L): front needs 2709 N·m/wheel (capacity 2.13×), rear needs 878 N·m/wheel (capacity 2.04×). `bias_front` = f + 0.9·h/L = 0.74 (ideal distribution at 0.9 g, clamped 0.55-0.78). Handbrake 1440 N·m per rear wheel.

## Steering

Ratio 15.5:1. Kerb-to-kerb turning circle 12.2 m → outer-front path radius 5.98 m, rear-axle-centre radius 4.41 m → mean road-wheel lock δ = atan(L/R) = **0.577 rad (33.0°)** (outer 28.7°, inner 38.7° at full Ackermann; `ackermann_frac` 0.60). Rack speed 1.4 rad/s.

## Damage lattice (`data/lattices/sentinel_vanguard.json`)

124 nodes, 714 beams, 4 detachables, 21 component mounts.

- Generated with `gen-box-lattice --id sentinel_vanguard --width 1.94 --length 5.05 --height 1.55 --wheelbase 2.87 --mass 456.5 --clearance 0.15` (22% of vehicle mass).
- Shaped top layer to the `sedan` profile (hood/deck/bumper tops dropped to beltline, greenhouse narrowed to 86% width).
- Beams: pillars + roof rails → hss 7.0e-04 m² (34 beams).
- Beams: cabin cell → hss 6.5e-04 m² (88 beams).
- Beams: sills → hss 6.0e-04 m² (6 beams).
- Beams: crumple (outer) rail segments → hss 2.0e-04 m² (36 beams).
- Beams: inner rail segments / firewall → hss 5.0e-04 m² (36 beams).
- Beams: hood → mild_steel 1.5e-04 m² (16 beams).
- Beams: outer panels → mild_steel 1.5e-04 m² (284 beams).
- Components: radiator at row 8 ahead of the engine (fails first), longitudinal engine at row 7, gearbox in the tunnel, prop shaft to the rear axle, fuel tank ahead of the rear axle.
- Detachables: FrontBumper 3000 N·s / 6 kg, RearBumper 3000 N·s / 6 kg, Hood 5000 N·s / 15 kg.
- Push bar: 4 extra FrontBumper nodes 0.10 m ahead of the bumper (z 0.35/0.8 m), hss 8.0e-04 m² tubes, bolted to the row-8 rail nodes through the bumper; detachable group 3 breaks at 15000 N·s (25 kg).
- Node mass: engine-mount nodes ×2.5, renormalised to 481 kg total.
